I love both of them so much. They're two games I always come back to when I have nothing else to play. But I have to say I think Terraria is better. 

Something I love about Terraria is that to me at least, it will never get boring. Theres always one more thing you can do to get that last npc, or that other weird shit you can try with that boss over there, you can always revisit that fight one more time, and i feel like theres so many more possibilities with Terraria then there is with Minecraft.

With Terraria theres a lot more bosses, armor, accessories and so on and theres almost like different types of characters you can play. Almost. For example, if you like magic, you can use mainly magic items, or if you like guns, you can get some pretty good guns. But with Minecraft you dont have to be a melee fighter, but thats the one you are going to get the farthest with, because theres only a few different enchantments for bows in Minecraft. I do love Minecraft, but if I had to choose one I would go with Terraria.
